Name: tf3d.generation.settings.update
Title: Update global generation settings
Description: Update selected generation-wide settings. Tile resolution changes resize generation resources and must fit the active GPU's texture-size limit; tile size maps to an integer tile count. Seed source mainModel resolves the current application mainModel slot, not a GPU handle or file path. Field storage changes are saved and report when restart is required. Applying resource changes may wait for current generation work to finish.
